The '''Derf system''' was a part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Sluis sector/Legends|Sluis sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with the [[Derf Chapter]] of the [[Max Rebo Fan Club]].<ref name="Insider67">{{InsiderCite|67|Who's Who in the Max Rebo Band}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Derf [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]]. The Online Companion placed it in grid square M-19.<ref name="EAOC" />
